LoveMeTwice is absolutely the best way to refresh wardrobes and perhaps even give away your own good clothes you are bored with! Save the planet - it’s begging for this to become a way of life now.

When  I first stepped into LoveMeTwice I wasn’t expecting much in terms of getting my size and quality or taste to my liking. Was I in for a surprise!  At a quarter of their origin prices too. I bought a stunning Zara silk dress (why would anyone give this away!) and several really terrific cotton tops and even khakis that fit way better than the pants I have. And accessories that were spot on! So very satisfying not to pay a bomb and come away thrilled.

I love the concept of giving good clothes new bodies instead of trashing it in land fills - considering the enormous expense, labour and resources every piece of clothing takes to produce.
